title: Taishi Huang
text: I’m originally from China. Before MDS, I spent 7 years working in Fintech data analysis across the US and China. I’ve grown especially interested in statistical inference and AI model reasoning — understanding why models make predictions, not just what they predict. I’m here to build a stronger foundation and stay at the frontier of the field.

title: About
text: I completed both my undergraduate degree and my first master’s degree in the United States, studying economics and statistics. Before MDS, I worked for seven years in banking and consulting, with roles in the US and China. My work focused on data analysis for legal and compliance teams.

title: About
text:
Why data science
Those years made it clear that I needed a more systematic training in data itself, not only in finance and mathematical statistics. I want stronger skills for industry work, and I want to keep up with what the AI era now expects.
